findings.evidence: Recession/Basic.lean:51 `variable {R V : Type*} [Semiring R] [PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R]`. Mathlib `Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem` takes any `Ring R`, and `finrank_sup_span_singleton` takes any field K.
findings.fix: Generalize the section to `{𝕜} [Field 𝕜] [LinearOrder 𝕜] [IsStrictOrderedRing 𝕜] [Module 𝕜 V]` with `t : 𝕜` in `sweep`. The ℝ uses in the Polyhedron and Topology files then become special cases.
findings.issue: `Set.sweep`, every lemma in the Algebra section and `Convex.sweep` require `[Module ℝ V]`, but the proofs only use ordered-field arithmetic and linear algebra. The mismatch with the R-general `recessionCone` and Mathlib's `Convex 𝕜` means `notMem_recessionCone_sweep` can only be stated for `recessionCone ℝ`.

findings.evidence: Mathlib Analysis/Convex/Intrinsic.lean:57 defines `intrinsicInterior` for any `[TopologicalSpace P] [AddTorsor V P]`. The proof of `mem_intrinsicInterior_of_sub_smul_mem_intrinsicInterior_sweep` only uses `continuous_subtype_val.sub continuous_const`.
findings.fix: Use `[AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] [TopologicalSpace V] [IsTopologicalAddGroup V] [ContinuousSMul ℝ V]` for these declarations. The intrinsic-interior lemmas need only the topological add-group part. Keep normed and finite-dimensional assumptions only for `IsClosed.sweep` and `sweepHomeomorph`.
findings.issue: `sweepProjection` and its lemmas, `sweep_eq_halfspace_inter_preimage`, `sweep_hyperplane` and the two intrinsic-interior lemmas (same variable block repeated at line 137) require `[NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]`. Their proofs only use `smulRight`, the continuous-affine-map constructors and continuity of subtraction.

summary: The algebraic sweep API is fixed to ℝ even though the neighbouring recession-cone and convexity APIs work over any ordered (semi)ring or field. The topology module assumes a normed space for lemmas whose proofs only need a topological vector space.
